name: Ano Fuji
source:
One of Yuna's few friends at Shirojo. A princess-like girl with long, flowing hair.

With all sorts of hobbies and an easygoing personality, her social circles are rather large. She'll help Yuna out in a pinch. She understands the yuri genre, but doesn't want anything to do with real life romance.

She'd be perfect if she wasn't ridiculously forgetful.

Strength: Sixth Sense
Weakness: Forgetfulness
Hobby: Anime, games, manga, the internet 
Skill: Overactive imagination, singing, piano, violin

[Taken from the [url=http://mangagamer.org/kindredspirits/]English official website[/url]]
